spine.entity: one threat image projection on a Central Search CT screen

world.org_type: a regional airport company owned by two councils, running its own security screening

driver: A unit's success rate is measured on test items drawn again and again from a small fixed pool, and a member succeeds more often on an item met before, so units whose members keep meeting the same few items look able while units drawing from a large pool look weak; only each member's first meeting with an item measures the ability the decision needs.
driver_concrete: Each team's chance of spotting a threat article it has never seen is read from its operators' threat image projections on images they met for the first time, because the Pier B screens draw their projections from a small legacy library that Fell's operators have met several times each, which lifts Fell's overall projection score to the middle of the table while its first-meeting detection is the lowest at the airport.
stump: A competent solver orders the 2027 remedial course by each team's 2026 threat image projection detection rate (Brook first at 71 per cent, Fell fourth at 80) or by d-prime against the clear searches (Esk first); the step that lands it there is treating every projection as a fresh test, when 4,104 of Fell's 5,229 projections in 2026 were images its operators had met before, and on the images each operator met for the first time Fell finds 63 per cent against 69 to 85 for the other teams.
